name: British Columbia: catalogue of bills given Royal Assent (metadata only, no law text) and legal-system facts
label: British Columbia
record_note: Metadata only, no law text: BC Laws, the official source, could not be used. The catalogue lists the 1502 bills given Royal Assent from 1992-03-31 to 2026-05-28, each dated by its assent day, with title, bill number and chapter number; checked against the Legislative Assembly records on 2026-10-30.

dates.commit: catalogue: the Royal Assent day; legal-system: the dated Wikidata fact, else the item's latest revision

reuse: No law text is reproduced. Bill numbers, titles, assent dates and chapter numbers are facts recorded by the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia; the legal-system facts are from Wikidata (CC0).
